requirement: A minimum separation distance of 100 m between offshore installations is prescribed.
Mooring lines must not be crossed within the mooring buffer zone.
The minimum distance between wind turbines is set to be 5 *D*.
No FOWT can be installed in the buffer zones of other FOWTs.
If Rw < RMooring, the constraint area should be determined by the mooring buffer zone.
If Rw - RMooring, the wind turbine buffer zone encompasses all mooring line areas.
The mooring line angle can be changed in 10 [°] intervals.
scope: Mooring line configuration for floating offshore wind turbines.

requirement: The minimum distance between FOWTs is set to be 6 *D*.
